title: CFTC Chair Says New Crypto Rulemaking Will Prevent Another FTX-Style Collapse
summary: Bitcoin Magazine CFTC Chair Says New Crypto Rulemaking Will Prevent Another FTX-Style Collapse CFTC Chair Mike Selig has said that the regulator wants to bring stringent regulations to the crypto world. This post CFTC Chair Says New Crypto Rulemaking Will Prevent Another FTX-Style Collapse first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
